name: comfy_dag
summary: Walks a ComfyUI install. Emits a deterministic JSONL chain cataloging every node class (builtin + comfy_extras + custom_nodes) and any saved workflows. Output is ParserCursor-compatible — same shape as scan_chain.jsonl. Feeds the workflow_card generator's --target comfyui surface.
engine_pattern: bash + python3 AST parser (extracts CATEGORY / INPUT_TYPES / RETURN_TYPES / FUNCTION / NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS from .py modules). Deterministic sort, bounded depth.
instructions: 2. Or with custom install: bash core/scripts/comfy_dag.sh /path/to/ComfyUI > ~/.cc/comfy_dag.jsonl
4. Find a specific node category: grep -E 'category.*loaders' ~/.cc/comfy_dag.jsonl
5. Workflow generator consumes this when emitting --target comfyui artifacts.
node_kinds_emitted: element name='install' depth=1 — per ComfyUI install (path, size, mtime)
element name='comfy_node' depth=3 — one per Python class (class_name, category, return_types, function, output_node)
element name='workflow' depth=2 — saved user workflow .json (path, node_count)
exports: bash script + python3 AST helpers inline
substrate: comfy_dag (in-memory JSONL — same retrieval shape as crystal chain)

inbound_callers: core/lib/moe_router.py (could index comfy_nodes alongside inference records — same n-gram hash space)
outbound_calls: python3 ast module for module parsing

guarantees: Deterministic — same install on disk → same JSONL bytes
Append-only — never overwrites existing entries; always emits fresh chain
Walkable — ParserCursor reads it identically to inference_master_chain or user_graph
Cross-substrate joinable — ngram hashes of class_name can match moe_router's
usage_example: cd /data/Projects/MySpace++ && bash core/scripts/comfy_dag.sh > ~/.cc/comfy_dag.jsonl && python3 core/lib/parser_cursor.py walk ~/.cc/comfy_dag.jsonl | head -30
